basedOn: Tafhim al-Qur'an by Sayyid Abul A'la Maududi (introduction)

sections.title: Where and when it was revealed
paragraphs: Most scholars say Makkah (a few said Madinah). The surah itself says "the Lord of this House", meaning the Ka'bah, which fits Makkah.

It was probably revealed right after Surah Al-Fil, because their meanings are closely linked. Some early Muslims even read them as one surah. But in the official copy of the Quran made in the time of 'Uthman, the Bismillah was written between them, so they are two separate surahs.

sections.title: The story behind it
paragraphs: Qusayy, an ancestor of the Prophet ﷺ, brought the tribe of Quraysh together in Makkah and took care of the pilgrims who came to the Ka'bah. Later, Hashim, the Prophet's ﷺ great-grandfather, started big trade journeys: in winter to Yemen and in summer to Syria. Makkah became the main trading city of Arabia.

After Allah destroyed the army of the elephant, all the Arabs respected the Quraysh as the people of Allah's House. Their caravans could travel anywhere safely, while other travellers were afraid of robbers.

sections.title: What it is about
paragraphs: The message is simple: you know this House is Allah's House, and you know it was Allah who gave you safety and food through it. So worship Him alone.
Allah reminds the Quraysh of His favour: He kept them together and safe in their city, and kept their trade journeys safe, in winter to Yemen and in summer to Syria.
People honoured them everywhere because they lived next to Allah's House. Ibn Jarir explains that the start of the surah means: "Look in wonder at how Allah blessed the Quraysh."
So they should thank Him in the best way: by worshipping only the Lord of this House, the One who gave them a safe city and a sacred House, with no idols beside Him.
He fed them when they would have been hungry, and gave them safety when they would have been afraid.
Ibn Kathir says: whoever obeys this command, Allah gives him safety in this life and the next. Whoever turns away from it, Allah can take both away.

sections.title: Di mana dan kapan surah ini turun
paragraphs: Sebagian besar ulama mengatakan di Makkah (sedikit yang mengatakan di Madinah). Surah ini sendiri menyebut "Tuhan pemilik Rumah ini", yaitu Ka'bah, yang cocok dengan Makkah.

Surah ini kemungkinan turun tepat setelah surah Al-Fil, karena maknanya sangat berkaitan. Sebagian kaum Muslim generasi awal bahkan membacanya sebagai satu surah. Tetapi dalam mushaf resmi yang ditulis pada masa Utsman, Basmalah ditulis di antara keduanya, sehingga keduanya adalah dua surah yang terpisah.

sections.title: Kisah di baliknya
paragraphs: Qushay, salah satu leluhur Nabi ﷺ, menyatukan suku Quraisy di Makkah dan melayani para jamaah yang datang ke Ka'bah. Kemudian Hasyim, kakek buyut Nabi ﷺ, memulai perjalanan dagang besar: di musim dingin ke Yaman dan di musim panas ke Syam. Makkah pun menjadi kota perdagangan utama di Arab.

Setelah Allah menghancurkan pasukan gajah, semua orang Arab menghormati kaum Quraisy sebagai penduduk Rumah Allah. Kafilah mereka bisa bepergian ke mana saja dengan aman, sementara para musafir lain takut dirampok.

sections.title: Isi surah ini
paragraphs: Pesannya sederhana: kalian tahu Rumah ini adalah Rumah Allah, dan kalian tahu bahwa Allah-lah yang memberi kalian rasa aman dan makanan melalui Rumah ini. Maka sembahlah Dia saja.

Allah mengingatkan kaum Quraisy akan nikmat-Nya: Dia menyatukan mereka dan menjaga mereka tetap aman di kota mereka, dan menjaga perjalanan dagang mereka, di musim dingin ke Yaman dan di musim panas ke Syam.

Orang-orang menghormati mereka di mana pun karena mereka tinggal di dekat Rumah Allah. Ibnu Jarir menjelaskan bahwa awal surah ini bermakna: "Lihatlah dengan kagum bagaimana Allah memberi nikmat kepada kaum Quraisy."
Maka mereka harus bersyukur dengan cara yang terbaik: menyembah hanya Tuhan pemilik Rumah ini, yang telah memberi mereka kota yang aman dan Rumah yang suci, tanpa berhala di samping-Nya.
Dia memberi mereka makan ketika mereka bisa saja kelaparan, dan memberi rasa aman ketika mereka bisa saja ketakutan.
Ibnu Katsir berkata: siapa yang menaati perintah ini, Allah memberinya rasa aman di dunia dan akhirat. Siapa yang berpaling darinya, Allah bisa mencabut keduanya.
